A1.justification: Both PDFs present the same Scone research work and contain 17 pages, including Appendices A–D. Text and rendered-page comparisons establish that the figures, tables, equations, and supplementary material are available for reliable comparison.

before.justification: v2 reports original benchmark results, qualitative comparisons, user studies, ablations, and threshold experiments in Section 5.

after.justification: v3 retains the original benchmark results, qualitative comparisons, user studies, ablations, and threshold experiments in Section 5.

M1.justification: The BAGEL-based architecture, two-stage training, semantic bridge, and attention masking remain unchanged. The feature-description edits do not specify any procedural modification.

E1.justification: Both versions use the same training data and evaluate on OmniContext and the same 409-case SconeEval benchmark, retaining composition, distinction, and combined tasks.

E2.justification: Tables 2–3 retain identical comparator sets, including BAGEL, OmniGen2, Echo-4o, GPT-4o, and Gemini-2.5-Flash-Image. The user-study comparator sets are also unchanged.

E3.justification: The evaluation metrics, GPT-4.1 scoring, 1024-by-1024 sampling, training budgets, and user-study design are unchanged. No new experimental condition or revised testing procedure is specified.

E4.justification: Both versions contain the same data-refinement and bridge ablations, threshold study, stability analysis, appendix layer visualizations, and failure examples.

E5.justification: Both report three sampling rounds with three scoring rounds each, averaging nine result groups. Figure 8's standard-deviation reporting and the qualitative comparisons' same-seed statement are unchanged.

E6.justification: All numerical results and qualitative outputs are identical. For example, Scone retains an OmniContext average of 8.01 in Table 2 and a SconeEval overall score of 8.50 in Table 3; ablation and user-study results also match.

T1.justification: The cosine-similarity, semantic-relevance, and attention-mask definitions in Equations 1–3 are unchanged. No formal assumptions, derivations, or proofs are added or revised.

C1.justification: The abstract, contribution statements, and conclusion retain the same claims about Scone, the understanding bridge, SconeEval, and leading performance among evaluated open-source methods.

C2.justification: Figure 1's caption changes the generation expert's contribution from 'texture information' to 'textual information'; Section 3.1 similarly changes 'before texture features emerge' to 'before textual features emerge.' These locally revise the feature-level explanation. Broader interpretations and Appendix D's limitations are unchanged.

D1.justification: Training-data quantities, construction and filtering instructions, layer-selection details, appendix prompts, and the model/data/code availability statement remain unchanged. No reproducibility information is added or removed.

R1.justification: The cited works, bibliography, related-work discussion, and positioning relative to prior methods are identical.

P1.justification: The only prose edits replace 'texture' with 'textual' in Figure 1's caption and Section 3.1. The arXiv version/date stamp is updated; section order and narrative structure remain unchanged.

P2.justification: Figure 1's caption has a small wording and spacing change, and the marginal arXiv stamp changes. All figure imagery, table structures, and placements remain unchanged; pages other than 1 and 3 render identically.

improvement.justification: The revision is confined to two feature-description substitutions and the version/date stamp. The method, experimental evidence, reproducibility information, and complete supplement are unchanged. These localized explanatory edits do not materially change the paper's overall quality or evidential support.
